# PLOT web app

PLOT is a film and television companion for tracking what you watch, keeping a watchlist, writing private notes and ratings, and deciding what to watch next.

This is the signed-in PLOT web app. Personal viewing history, lists, ratings, notes, and account details are private. Agents must not claim access to them without the member's authenticated, explicit permission.

There is no public API for member data. PLOT's public endpoints are listed at https://theplot.tv/.well-known/api-catalog and cover newsletter signup only. For public product information, see https://theplot.tv/about.html and https://theplot.tv/plans.html.
